title: pseudorchis albida subsp. tricuspis
intro: Pseudorchis albida subsp. tricuspis, commonly known as the white orchid or Tricuspis orchid, is a plant species within the genus Pseudorchis, belonging to the orchid family (Orchidaceae). It has been traditionally used in medicine, primarily in the European Alps, where it is valued for its potential health benefits in treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pseudorchis albida subsp. tricuspis include its ability to stimulate the secretion of mucus in the respiratory tract, making it easier to expel and relieving congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
